verses.text: Paul, and Silas, and Timothy. We write to the church of the Thessalonians. The church is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
We give thanks to God always for you all. We make mention of you in our prayers.

We remember without ceasing (stopping) your work of faith, and labour (hard work) of love. We remember your patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. We remember it in the sight of God and our Father.
Brothers beloved (dearly loved), we know your election (choosing) by God.

For our gospel (good news) came to you not in word only. It also came in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and in much assurance (being sure). You know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
And you became followers of us, and of the Lord. You received the word in much affliction (trouble), with joy of the Holy Spirit.
So you were ensamples (examples) to all who believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
For from you sounded out (spread) the word of the Lord. It spread not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place. Your faith toward God is spread abroad. So we need not speak anything.
For they themselves show of us what manner of entering in we had to you. They tell how you turned to God from idols. You turned to serve the living and true God,
And to wait for His Son from heaven. God raised His Son from the dead. He is Jesus, who delivered (rescued) us from the wrath (God's anger) to come.

verses.text: For you yourselves, brothers, know our entrance in to you. You know that it was not in vain (for nothing).

Before that, we had suffered and were shamefully entreated (treated) at Philippi, as you know. Yet we were bold in our God to speak to you the gospel (good news) of God. We spoke it with much contention (fighting against us).
For our exhortation (encouragement) was not of deceit (lies), nor of uncleanness (impure motives), nor in guile (trickery).
But we were allowed (approved) by God to be put in trust with the gospel (good news). So we speak, not as pleasing people, but God. God tries (tests) our hearts.
For we did not at any time use flattering words, as you know. We did not use a cloke (cover) of covetousness (wanting what belongs to others). God is witness.
We did not seek glory from people, neither from you, nor from others. We might have been burdensome (a burden to you), as the apostles (sent ones) of Christ.
But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherishes (cares for) her children.
So we were affectionately desirous (longing) of you. We were willing to give you the gospel (good news) of God, and also our own souls. This was because you were dear to us.

For you remember, brothers, our labour (hard work) and travail (toil). We laboured (worked hard) night and day, because we would not be chargeable (a cost) to any of you. We preached to you the gospel (good news) of God.
You are witnesses, and God also. We behaved ourselves holily and justly and unblameably (without blame) among you who believe.
You know how we exhorted (encouraged) and comforted and charged (told) every one of you. We did it as a father does his children,
That you would walk worthy of God. God has called you to His kingdom and glory.

For this cause also we thank God without ceasing (stopping). You received the word of God which you heard from us. You received it not as the word of men. You received it as it is in truth, the word of God. It effectually (powerfully) works also in you who believe.

For you, brothers, became followers of the churches of God in Judaea. Those churches are in Christ Jesus. You also have suffered like things from your own countrymen. You suffered even as they have from the Jews.
Those Jews both killed the Lord Jesus, and their own prophets, and have persecuted (attacked for faith) us. They do not please God, and are contrary (opposed) to all people.

They forbid us to speak to the Gentiles (people who are not Jews) that they might be saved. They do this to fill up their sins always. For the wrath (God's anger) is come upon them to the uttermost (full).
But we, brothers, were taken from you for a short time, in presence, not in heart. We endeavoured (tried) more abundantly to see your face with great desire.
So we would have come to you, even I Paul, once and again. But Satan hindered (stopped) us.
For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Are not even you, in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at His coming?
For you are our glory and joy.
So we could no longer forbear (wait). We thought it good to be left at Athens alone.

And we sent Timothy, our brother. Timothy is a minister (servant) of God, and our fellowlabourer (fellow worker) in the gospel (good news) of Christ. We sent him to establish (make firm) you, and to comfort you concerning your faith.
We did this so that no one should be moved by these afflictions (troubles). For you yourselves know that we are appointed to this.
For truly, when we were with you, we told you before. We said we would suffer tribulation (trouble). Even so it came to pass (happened), as you know.
For this cause, when I could no longer forbear (wait), I sent to know your faith. I feared that the tempter (the devil) had tempted you. Then our labour (hard work) would be in vain (for nothing).

But now Timothy came from you to us. Timothy brought us good tidings (news) of your faith and charity (love). And he told us that you have good remembrance of us always. You desire greatly to see us, as we also desire to see you.
Therefore, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our affliction (trouble) and distress (hardship) by your faith.
For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.
For what thanks can we render (give) to God again for you? We thank God for all the joy we have. We joy for your sakes before our God.
Night and day we pray exceedingly (very much) that we might see your face. We want to perfect (complete) that which is lacking in your faith.
Now may God Himself and our Father direct our way to you. May our Lord Jesus Christ direct it too.
And may the Lord make you to increase and abound (overflow) in love one toward another. May you abound (overflow) in love toward all people, even as we do toward you.

May the Lord stablish (make firm) your hearts unblameable (without blame) in holiness before God, even our Father. May this be at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all His saints (holy people).

verses.text: Furthermore then we beseech (beg) you, brothers, and exhort (encourage) you by the Lord Jesus. You have received from us how you ought to walk and to please God. So abound (grow) more and more.
For you know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
For this is the will of God, even your sanctification (being made holy). You should abstain (stay away) from fornication (sexual sin).
Every one of you should know how to possess (control) his vessel (body) in sanctification (being made holy) and honour.
Do not live in the lust (wrong desire) of concupiscence (evil desire). That is how the Gentiles (people who are not Jews) live, who do not know God.
No one should go beyond and defraud (cheat) their brother in any matter. For the Lord is the avenger (one who pays back) of all such. We also have forewarned (warned before) you and testified.
For God has not called us to uncleanness (impure living), but to holiness.
So whoever despises (rejects) this does not despise people, but God. God has also given to us His Holy Spirit.
But as touching brotherly love you need not that I write to you. For you yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
And indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we beseech (beg) you, brothers, that you increase more and more,
And that you study (try hard) to be quiet, and to do your own business. Work with your own hands, as we commanded you.
Then you may walk honestly toward those who are without (outside the church). And you may have lack of nothing.
But I would not have you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who are asleep (have died). Then you will not sorrow (be sad), even as others who have no hope.
For we believe that Jesus died and rose again. Even so, those who sleep in Jesus, God will bring with Him.
For this we say to you by the word of the Lord. We who are alive at the Lord's coming will not prevent (go ahead of) those who are asleep (have died).

For the Lord Himself will descend (come down) from heaven with a shout. He will come with the voice of the archangel (chief angel), and with the trump (trumpet) of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first.
Then we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them. We will be caught up in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will ever be with the Lord.
So comfort one another with these words.

verses.text: But you have no need that I write to you, brothers. You know of the times and the seasons.
You yourselves know this perfectly. The day of the Lord so comes as a thief in the night.
For when they will say, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction comes upon them. It comes as travail (birth pains) upon a woman with child (pregnant). And they will not escape.
But you, brothers, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
You are all the children of light, and the children of the day. We are not of the night, nor of darkness.
Therefore let us not sleep, as others do. But let us watch (stay alert) and be sober (clear-minded).
For those who sleep, sleep in the night. And those who are drunken are drunken in the night.
But let us, who are of the day, be sober (clear-minded). Let us put on the breastplate (chest armor) of faith and love. And for a helmet, let us put on the hope of salvation.
For God has not appointed us to wrath (God's anger). God appointed us to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ.
Christ died for us. So whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with Him.
So comfort yourselves together, and edify (build up) one another, even as also you do.
And we beseech (beg) you, brothers, to know those who labour (work hard) among you. They are over you in the Lord, and admonish (warn) you.
Esteem (think of) them very highly in love for their work's sake. And be at peace among yourselves.
Now we exhort (encourage) you, brothers: Warn those who are unruly (out of line). Comfort the feebleminded (fainthearted). Support the weak. Be patient toward all people.
See that no one renders (pays back) evil for evil to anyone. But ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all people.
Rejoice evermore (always).
Pray without ceasing (stopping).
In every thing give thanks. For this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
Do not quench (put out) the Spirit.
Do not despise (look down on) prophesyings (God's messages).
Prove (test) all things. Hold fast that which is good.
Abstain (stay away) from all appearance of evil.

May the very God of peace sanctify (make holy) you wholly (completely). I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved (kept) blameless. May they be kept blameless to the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Faithful is God who calls you. God also will do it.
Brothers, pray for us.
Greet all the brothers with an holy kiss.
I charge (strongly tell) you by the Lord that this epistle (letter) be read to all the holy brothers.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
